description: A top free, paid or grossing chart for a store, country and category, today or on a past date: rank, app, developer, rating and the move since the previous capture (new entries marked), plus apps that dropped out. Charts are captured daily for every country and category. Cost: 1 credits.

category.description: App Store genre id (`36` or `all` = all apps, `6014` = games, …) or Play category (`GAME_PUZZLE`; `APPLICATION` = all apps).

date.description: The chart as of this date (ISO). Default the latest capture.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

limit.description: How many ranks to return (default 100, max 200).

name: get_charts
title: Get Charts
